why:
All three verification steps pass, and none of the refutation grounds apply.

**1. Quote is verbatim.** `curl -sL https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks.md` → 3173 lines. `grep -cF` on the full claimed sentence returns 1 (hooks.md:1220), character-for-character including the `[common input fields](#common-input-fields)` link. The matcher half of the claim is also verbatim at hooks.md:1216 — "Matches on `command_name`. Leave the matcher empty to fire on every prompt-type command." (`grep -cF` → 1). The doc's own JSON example at hooks.md:1222-1236 shows all five fields populated (`expansion_type: "slash_command"`, `command_name: "example-skill"`, `command_args: "arg1 arg2"`, `command_source: "plugin"`, `prompt: "/example-skill arg1 arg2"`).

**2. Cited file:line says what was claimed.** `/Users/i.i.gavrikov/Desktop/work/nessy-desktop/packages/pi-agent-server/src/extensions/lifecycle-bridge.ts:122-125` emits exactly:
```ts
await options.emit('UserPromptExpansion', {
  hook_event_name: 'UserPromptExpansion', source: 'pi-before-agent-start',
  lifecycle_version: 1, correlation_id: currentTurnCorrelation,
})
```
It sits inside `pi.on('before_agent_start', …)` (line 116), immediately after the `UserPromptSubmit` emission — i.e. once per turn, not per command expansion. `grep -ran "expansion_type" packages apps` → 0 hits (only `docs/`). The once-per-turn shape is also frozen as a contract row in `packages/shared/src/automations/types.ts:52`: `terminalDelivery: 'once-per-turn'`, `redactedPayload: ['source', 'correlation_id']`.

**3. One layer down — the second emitter does not rescue it.** `packages/shared/src/agent/pi-agent.ts:6423` (the host-side `runPiPromptGate`) re-emits the event so a block can be honoured before `send({type:'prompt'})`, and it is deliberately kept "byte-identical" to the bridge's shape: `{ hook_event_name: 'UserPromptExpansion', source: 'pi-before-agent-start', lifecycle_version: 1 }`. No producer anywhere supplies the five documented fields.

**3b. One layer up — the matcher confirms the consequence.** `packages/shared/src/automations/utils.ts:161` `getMatchValueForSdkInput` has case arms for 17 events; `UserPromptExpansion` is **not** among them, so it hits `default: return ''` (with the reason spelled out at utils.ts:233-234). `UserPromptExpansion` is also **not** in `MATCHERLESS_AGENT_EVENTS` (utils.ts:260-269), so `matchesBasePredicate` (utils.ts:286) does not short-circuit to `true` — a narrowing matcher is regex/exact-compared against `''` and never fires. The consequence is real, not just the identifier.

**3c. Sibling-subsystem check — the Claude-SDK backend is not an escape.** `claude-agent.ts:1286` feeds `this.automationSystem.buildSdkHooks()` to the installed Agent SDK, and `buildSdkHooksForConfig` (hooks-automation.ts:1636) *does* forward `matcher: matcher.matcher`, so on that path the SDK itself would produce the five fields and pre-filter. But the callback then re-runs `executePluginHookAutomations` → `pluginMatcherMatches` → `matcherMatchesSdk` → the same `''`, so the hook is dropped on the second pass. Independently recorded at `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-29-inert-worklist.md:62` ("the Claude-SDK path re-enters the same check … so it is not an escape"). Additionally `NESSY_FEATURE_PROVIDER_CLAUDE` defaults **off** and Pi is the shipped default backend, so the Pi bridge is the live path.

**Not an owner decision.** The nine dated decisions in `2026-07-29-inert-worklist.md` §3 are `SEATBELT_TESTING_WILDCARD`, `availableModels`/`enforceAvailableModels`, `autoMode.classifyAllShell`, `ManagedDeliveryStateV1.drops`, `plugins/hooks-runtime.ts`, `SdkMcpServerConfig.required`, `SessionMirrorStore.delete`, `MirrorSessionKey.subpath`/`listSubkeys`, and `listSessionSummaries`/`listSessions`. This is none of them. It goes the other way: the same file lists it in **§2 Live defects → user-visible** (line 62, the "9 matcher-bearing events return `''`" row, sized **large**) and in **§5 as unit U-B**. The plan that executed U-B, `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-29-inert-unit-b.md`, deliberately left this arm unfilled with a stated reason — ":166 … *Cost:* the documented use case (block `/deploy` without an approval file) is unreachable; **it needs the event, not the matcher**" — and files the payload half under "**Propagation found — reported, not fixed**" (item 4: the five fields have no emitter; item 5: "`UserPromptExpansion` fires once per turn (Claude's per slash-command or MCP-prompt expansion) … each is its own unit"). Carried into the generated register at `2026-07-29-deviation-register.md:333`. So it is an acknowledged, deliberately-deferred gap — recorded, but open, and explicitly scoped as future work.

**Not a de-brand / product difference.** Nothing here touches subscription flows, the corporate gateway, or the NESSY_ rename. Nessy imports Claude and Codex plugins that ship commands and skills, and `harness-tool-descriptor.ts:161/294` registers a `slash_command` tool bound to `SlashCommand` — so the expansion path the event is supposed to observe exists in this fork; it just has no hook emission attached to it.

**One imprecision in the claimed state, not enough to refute.** The claim says "our emission carries only `source`, `lifecycle_version` and `correlation_id`". That is exact for the bridge (lifecycle-bridge.ts:122-125); the second, host-side emitter (pi-agent.ts:6423) is one field shorter — it omits `correlation_id`. Both also carry `hook_event_name`. Neither carries any of the five documented fields, so the finding's substance stands.
correctedState: Confirmed with two refinements. Nessy emits `UserPromptExpansion` from **two** places, both once per turn and neither per command expansion: (1) `packages/pi-agent-server/src/extensions/lifecycle-bridge.ts:122-125`, inside `pi.on('before_agent_start')`, carrying `{hook_event_name, source: 'pi-before-agent-start', lifecycle_version: 1, correlation_id}`; and (2) the host-side prompt gate `packages/shared/src/agent/pi-agent.ts:6423`, carrying the same shape minus `correlation_id` (kept "byte-identical so a hook reading it sees no change but a block"). None of `expansion_type`, `command_name`, `command_args`, `command_source` or `prompt` has any producer (`grep -ran expansion_type packages apps` → 0). The matcher consequence also holds and is independently caused: `getMatchValueForSdkInput` (packages/shared/src/automations/utils.ts:161) has no `UserPromptExpansion` arm and falls to `default: return ''`, and the event is absent from `MATCHERLESS_AGENT_EVENTS` (utils.ts:260-269), so `matchesBasePredicate` compares a narrowing matcher against `''` and it never fires — on the Claude-SDK backend too, because `buildSdkHooksForConfig` forwards the matcher to the SDK but the callback re-runs the same check. The gap is already recorded — `hooks-automation.ts:349` registers it in `MATCHER_INERT_AGENT_EVENTS` so authors are warned at registration, `automations/types.ts:52` freezes `terminalDelivery: 'once-per-turn'`, and `2026-07-29-inert-unit-b.md` files both halves under "Propagation found — reported, not fixed" — but it is recorded as OPEN work ("it needs the event, not the matcher"; "each is its own unit"), listed as a live user-visible defect in inert-worklist §2 line 62 and as unit U-B in §5. It is not among the nine §3 owner decisions.
